module: "Delivery > Routes" career debug tab. 'Delivery Access Points' ImGui window listing the delivery facilities and their access points (accessPointsByName), with selection of a point. Also contains a mouse raycast (updateMouseInfo) and an arc drawing helper, largely unfinished.
notes: Development tool, partly unfinished: drawRoute is empty, drawArc is not called anywhere, the 'mouse clicking' block is empty.
updateMouseInfo disables then re-enables forest collision around the mouse raycast.

debugOrder.desc: Sort order in the debug window (10).

onCareerActivated.desc: Career hook: stores the delivery modules (parcelManager, cargoScreen, general, generator, progress, vehicleOfferManager).

drawDebugMenu.desc: Draws the 'Delivery Access Points' window: tree of facilities (career_modules_delivery_generator.getFacilities) with their selectable access points.

updateMouseInfo.desc: Updates the local mouseInfo table: camera position, mouse ray, result of cameraMouseRayCast, down/hold/up states of the left button (outside ImGui capture) and click, hold and release positions/normals.
